meta.title: Change and Confusion
meta.description: The voice whispering by your side cannot be silenced, and the sacred commandments seem so far away.

units.rawText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector, at the former Sanctifier Watchtower [objectTower_b3].
units.displayText: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector, at the former Sanctifier Watchtower [objectTower_b3].

spans.text: In the Middle Ring of the Tartarus Sector, at the former Sanctifier Watchtower [objectTower_b3].

units.rawText: The plain longsword clashes with a purple tentacle, and the former leaves a mark on the latter.
units.displayText: The plain longsword clashes with a purple tentacle, and the former leaves a mark on the latter.

spans.text: The plain longsword clashes with a purple tentacle, and the former leaves a mark on the latter.

units.rawText: Oh? Not bad...
units.displayText: Oh? Not bad...

spans.text: Oh? Not bad...

units.rawText: Malkira doesn't seem worried by how Ptolemaea is struggling. All she does is watch with mild interest.
units.displayText: Malkira doesn't seem worried by how Ptolemaea is struggling. All she does is watch with mild interest.

spans.text: Malkira doesn't seem worried by how Ptolemaea is struggling. All she does is watch with mild interest.

units.rawText: Why aren't you stepping in, Malkira?
units.displayText: Why aren't you stepping in, Malkira?

spans.text: Why aren't you stepping in, Malkira?

units.rawText: You don't think small fry like this could possibly stop me, do you?
units.displayText: You don't think small fry like this could possibly stop me, do you?

spans.text: You don't think small fry like this could possibly stop me, do you?

units.rawText: Biologically speaking, these little ones aren't "fry", as in the young of fish. Also, our dance is not yet over...
units.displayText: Biologically speaking, these little ones aren't "fry", as in the young of fish. Also, our dance is not yet over...

spans.text: Biologically speaking, these little ones aren't "fry", as in the young of fish. Also, our dance is not yet over...

units.rawText: Eosphorus ignores Ptolemaea and cuts her in half with a single swing.
units.displayText: Eosphorus ignores Ptolemaea and cuts her in half with a single swing.

spans.text: Eosphorus ignores Ptolemaea and cuts her in half with a single swing.

units.rawText: But just like before, another Jellyfish Entropic quickly changes into Ptolemaea and continues battling Eosphorus.
units.displayText: But just like before, another Jellyfish Entropic quickly changes into Ptolemaea and continues battling Eosphorus.

spans.text: But just like before, another Jellyfish Entropic quickly changes into Ptolemaea and continues battling Eosphorus.

units.rawText: My power is limitless, yet your jellyfish clones wither and die by the second.
units.displayText: My power is limitless, yet your jellyfish clones wither and die by the second.

spans.text: My power is limitless, yet your jellyfish clones wither and die by the second.

units.rawText: Eosphorus calmly fends off Ptolemaea's attacks, but his gaze remains fixed on Malkira.
units.displayText: Eosphorus calmly fends off Ptolemaea's attacks, but his gaze remains fixed on Malkira.

spans.text: Eosphorus calmly fends off Ptolemaea's attacks, but his gaze remains fixed on Malkira.

units.rawText: Hehehe...
units.displayText: Hehehe...

spans.text: Hehehe...

units.rawText: Your bladework is flawless, but you've grown more talkative.
units.displayText: Your bladework is flawless, but you've grown more talkative.

spans.text: Your bladework is flawless, but you've grown more talkative.

units.rawText: Malkira's taunt does not so much as perturb Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Malkira's taunt does not so much as perturb Eosphorus.

spans.text: Malkira's taunt does not so much as perturb Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Several meteors of operands streak past and evaporate all the Jellyfish Entropics in an instant.
units.displayText: Several meteors of operands streak past and evaporate all the Jellyfish Entropics in an instant.

spans.text: Several meteors of operands streak past and evaporate all the Jellyfish Entropics in an instant.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Losing all those Jellyfish Entropics has gravely wounded Ptolemaea, who can only step aside.
units.displayText: Losing all those Jellyfish Entropics has gravely wounded Ptolemaea, who can only step aside.

spans.text: Losing all those Jellyfish Entropics has gravely wounded Ptolemaea, who can only step aside.

units.rawText: Although she's on her last legs, Ptolemaea still seems calm and composed, and not like someone on the verge of death.
units.displayText: Although she's on her last legs, Ptolemaea still seems calm and composed, and not like someone on the verge of death.

spans.text: Although she's on her last legs, Ptolemaea still seems calm and composed, and not like someone on the verge of death.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his sword and points it at Malkira.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his sword and points it at Malkira.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his sword and points it at Malkira.

units.rawText: ...That's enough testing for now, Malkira. Or do you think such games will anger me enough to expose a weakness to you?
units.displayText: ...That's enough testing for now, Malkira. Or do you think such games will anger me enough to expose a weakness to you?

spans.text: ...That's enough testing for now, Malkira. Or do you think such games will anger me enough to expose a weakness to you?

units.rawText: What you truly want to ask is, "Why did I watch as one of my minions was destroyed?" Is it not?
units.displayText: What you truly want to ask is, "Why did I watch as one of my minions was destroyed?" Is it not?

spans.text: What you truly want to ask is, "Why did I watch as one of my minions was destroyed?" Is it not?

units.rawText: Perhaps I might just be adhering to the rules of honor and not using the advantage of numbers against you.
units.displayText: Perhaps I might just be adhering to the rules of honor and not using the advantage of numbers against you.

spans.text: Perhaps I might just be adhering to the rules of honor and not using the advantage of numbers against you.

units.rawText: A mere Entropic dares talk about honor? Regardless of why you sent your minion to her death, it is now your turn.
units.displayText: A mere Entropic dares talk about honor? Regardless of why you sent your minion to her death, it is now your turn.

spans.text: A mere Entropic dares talk about honor? Regardless of why you sent your minion to her death, it is now your turn.

units.rawText: Oh, I like this side of you. Certain in your goal and unflinching in your faith.
units.displayText: Oh, I like this side of you. Certain in your goal and unflinching in your faith.

spans.text: Oh, I like this side of you. Certain in your goal and unflinching in your faith.

units.rawText: But Eosphorus... Have you ever doubted that voice you obey?
units.displayText: But Eosphorus... Have you ever doubted that voice you obey?

spans.text: But Eosphorus... Have you ever doubted that voice you obey?

units.rawText: Are you trying to challenge my faith? Your words are utterly meaningless.
units.displayText: Are you trying to challenge my faith? Your words are utterly meaningless.

spans.text: Are you trying to challenge my faith? Your words are utterly meaningless.

units.rawText: Humph. Meaningless, you say?
units.displayText: Humph. Meaningless, you say?

spans.text: Humph. Meaningless, you say?

units.rawText: Was the fact that all of your group lost half their operands the moment you obtained the Rubik's Map just as meaningless?
units.displayText: Was the fact that all of your group lost half their operands the moment you obtained the Rubik's Map just as meaningless?

spans.text: Was the fact that all of your group lost half their operands the moment you obtained the Rubik's Map just as meaningless?

units.rawText: A mere diversion; even with half my operands, destroying you all is—
units.displayText: A mere diversion; even with half my operands, destroying you all is—

spans.text: A mere diversion; even with half my operands, destroying you all is—

units.rawText: Have you considered WHY you lost <color=orange>exactly half of your operands?</color>
units.displayText: Have you considered WHY you lost exactly half of your operands?

spans.text: Have you considered WHY you lost
exactly half of your operands?

units.rawText: Why did each and every one of you have all your parameters cut exactly in half, from your operands to your attack power, defensive strength, even your reflexes and agility?
units.displayText: Why did each and every one of you have all your parameters cut exactly in half, from your operands to your attack power, defensive strength, even your reflexes and agility?

spans.text: Why did each and every one of you have all your parameters cut
exactly
in half, from your operands to your attack power, defensive strength, even your reflexes and agility?

units.rawText: And the Halo... What a lovely name. You lost half your operands last time, so what kind of price do you think you'll have to pay to activate the full Halo? Aren't you even the least bit curious?
units.displayText: And the Halo... What a lovely name. You lost half your operands last time, so what kind of price do you think you'll have to pay to activate the full Halo? Aren't you even the least bit curious?

spans.text: And the Halo... What a lovely name. You lost half your operands last time, so what kind of price do you think you'll have to pay to activate the full Halo? Aren't you even the least bit curious?

units.rawText: If that's all you want to say, then you may die now.
units.displayText: If that's all you want to say, then you may die now.

spans.text: If that's all you want to say, then you may die now.

units.rawText: Once again, Eosphorus answers Malkira's mockery with his sword. A storm of countless shining blades rains down on Malkira.
units.displayText: Once again, Eosphorus answers Malkira's mockery with his sword. A storm of countless shining blades rains down on Malkira.

spans.text: Once again, Eosphorus answers Malkira's mockery with his sword. A storm of countless shining blades rains down on Malkira.

units.rawText: Yes, that's it. As the leader of the Sanctifiers, you will always fight with calm and aplomb~
units.displayText: Yes, that's it. As the leader of the Sanctifiers, you will always fight with calm and aplomb~

spans.text: Yes, that's it. As the leader of the Sanctifiers, you will always fight with calm and aplomb~

units.rawText: Malkira waves her hands, and six tentacles stab at Eosphorus like streaks of lightning.
units.displayText: Malkira waves her hands, and six tentacles stab at Eosphorus like streaks of lightning.

spans.text: Malkira waves her hands, and six tentacles stab at Eosphorus like streaks of lightning.

units.rawText: Humph...
units.displayText: Humph...

spans.text: Humph...

units.rawText: Before the tentacles can close around him, Eosphorus swings his sword and severs all the purple appendages at once. His stroke also causes motes of starlight to appear above everyone's heads.
units.displayText: Before the tentacles can close around him, Eosphorus swings his sword and severs all the purple appendages at once. His stroke also causes motes of starlight to appear above everyone's heads.

spans.text: Before the tentacles can close around him, Eosphorus swings his sword and severs all the purple appendages at once. His stroke also causes motes of starlight to appear above everyone's heads.

units.rawText: That's right, that's the way!
units.displayText: That's right, that's the way!

spans.text: That's right, that's the way!

units.rawText: Malkira excitedly swipes her black tentacles at the stars above. The tentacles smash them to pieces, but right after that, a sharp blade severs the tentacles.
units.displayText: Malkira excitedly swipes her black tentacles at the stars above. The tentacles smash them to pieces, but right after that, a sharp blade severs the tentacles.

spans.text: Malkira excitedly swipes her black tentacles at the stars above. The tentacles smash them to pieces, but right after that, a sharp blade severs the tentacles.

units.rawText: Although it looks like nothing more than a close shave, each of Eosphorus' attacks is doing appreciable damage to Malkira.
units.displayText: Although it looks like nothing more than a close shave, each of Eosphorus' attacks is doing appreciable damage to Malkira.

spans.text: Although it looks like nothing more than a close shave, each of Eosphorus' attacks is doing appreciable damage to Malkira.

units.rawText: The intense battle releases tremendous amounts of operands into the air, which begins to feel sticky.
units.displayText: The intense battle releases tremendous amounts of operands into the air, which begins to feel sticky.

spans.text: The intense battle releases tremendous amounts of operands into the air, which begins to feel sticky.

units.rawText: However, Malkira still pays it no heed.
units.displayText: However, Malkira still pays it no heed.

spans.text: However, Malkira still pays it no heed.

units.rawText: So, are you feeling anything right now?
units.displayText: So, are you feeling anything right now?

spans.text: So, are you feeling anything right now?

units.rawText: Are you thinking that you shouldn't be wasting operands like this, even if I'm just a clone?
units.displayText: Are you thinking that you shouldn't be wasting operands like this, even if I'm just a clone?

spans.text: Are you thinking that you shouldn't be wasting operands like this, even if I'm just a clone?

units.rawText: I did not expect the Entropic leader to be quite so talkative.
units.displayText: I did not expect the Entropic leader to be quite so talkative.

spans.text: I did not expect the Entropic leader to be quite so talkative.

units.rawText: Hehe.
units.displayText: Hehe.

spans.text: Hehe.

units.rawText: For a moment, the mocking tone disappears from Malkira's voice, and she speaks quietly.
units.displayText: For a moment, the mocking tone disappears from Malkira's voice, and she speaks quietly.

spans.text: For a moment, the mocking tone disappears from Malkira's voice, and she speaks quietly.

units.rawText: So you're not afraid because you've got something up your sleeve, then, is that it?
units.displayText: So you're not afraid because you've got something up your sleeve, then, is that it?

spans.text: So you're not afraid because you've got something up your sleeve, then, is that it?

units.rawText: I hope you will be able to keep saying that once I crush your confidence to bits.
units.displayText: I hope you will be able to keep saying that once I crush your confidence to bits.

spans.text: I hope you will be able to keep saying that once I crush your confidence to bits.

units.rawText: Eosphorus glances at Ptolemaea out of the corner of his eye.
units.displayText: Eosphorus glances at Ptolemaea out of the corner of his eye.

spans.text: Eosphorus glances at Ptolemaea out of the corner of his eye.

units.rawText: Her jellyfish are gone, she's on the verge of death, her master has been critically wounded, but she still looks as composed as ever.
units.displayText: Her jellyfish are gone, she's on the verge of death, her master has been critically wounded, but she still looks as composed as ever.

spans.text: Her jellyfish are gone, she's on the verge of death, her master has been critically wounded, but she still looks as composed as ever.

units.rawText: Tsk...
units.displayText: Tsk...

spans.text: Tsk...

units.rawText: (Whatever the reason, letting things drag on will be problematic.)
units.displayText: Whatever the reason, letting things drag on will be problematic.

spans.text: Whatever the reason, letting things drag on will be problematic.

units.rawText: With that, Eosphorus leaps back and begins channeling operands into his holy blade.
units.displayText: With that, Eosphorus leaps back and begins channeling operands into his holy blade.

spans.text: With that, Eosphorus leaps back and begins channeling operands into his holy blade.

units.rawText: Hehe... It's time to show you something interesting—
units.displayText: Hehe... It's time to show you something interesting—

spans.text: Hehe... It's time to show you something interesting—

units.rawText: Eosphorus swings his sacred sword, but Malkira seems to have been waiting for this moment and charges right into it.
units.displayText: Eosphorus swings his sacred sword, but Malkira seems to have been waiting for this moment and charges right into it.

spans.text: Eosphorus swings his sacred sword, but Malkira seems to have been waiting for this moment and charges right into it.

units.rawText: Stab—
units.displayText: Stab—

spans.text: Stab—

units.rawText: The sensation of the blade penetrating a body makes Eosphorus freeze up for a moment. Even Malkira could not withstand such an attack.
units.displayText: The sensation of the blade penetrating a body makes Eosphorus freeze up for a moment. Even Malkira could not withstand such an attack.

spans.text: The sensation of the blade penetrating a body makes Eosphorus freeze up for a moment. Even Malkira could not withstand such an attack.

units.rawText: And it is precisely at this moment that Malkira opens her terminal in front of Eosphorus.
units.displayText: And it is precisely at this moment that Malkira opens her terminal in front of Eosphorus.

spans.text: And it is precisely at this moment that Malkira opens her terminal in front of Eosphorus.

units.rawText: <color=orange><size=60>Tartarus Watchtower—First-Generation Sanctifier Journal</size></color>
units.displayText: Tartarus Watchtower—First-Generation Sanctifier Journal

spans.text: Tartarus Watchtower—First-Generation Sanctifier Journal

units.rawText: Malkira does not seem the slightest bit pained even though she's been run through by Eosphorus' longsword.
units.displayText: Malkira does not seem the slightest bit pained even though she's been run through by Eosphorus' longsword.

spans.text: Malkira does not seem the slightest bit pained even though she's been run through by Eosphorus' longsword.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: You want to know why I have an encrypted Sanctifier diary with me?
units.displayText: You want to know why I have an encrypted Sanctifier diary with me?

spans.text: You want to know why I have an encrypted Sanctifier diary with me?

units.rawText: Why don't you think about it—Why would anyone call themselves <color=orange>"First-Generation"</color> when writing a diary?
units.displayText: Why don't you think about it—Why would anyone call themselves "First-Generation" when writing a diary?

spans.text: Why don't you think about it—Why would anyone call themselves
"First-Generation"
when writing a diary?

units.rawText: Were there other Sanctifiers before you, Eosphorus? Did you see any of them?
units.displayText: Were there other Sanctifiers before you, Eosphorus? Did you see any of them?

spans.text: Were there other Sanctifiers before you, Eosphorus? Did you see any of them?

units.rawText: Did the <color=orange>"Ancient War"</color> actually exist? If the "first generation" had the technology to build "Watchtowers", then why could they not reach me?
units.displayText: Did the "Ancient War" actually exist? If the "first generation" had the technology to build "Watchtowers", then why could they not reach me?

spans.text: Did the
"Ancient War"
actually exist? If the "first generation" had the technology to build "Watchtowers", then why could they not reach me?

units.rawText: And what exactly are those <color=orange>"revelations"</color> that you serve, anyway?
units.displayText: And what exactly are those "revelations" that you serve, anyway?

spans.text: And what exactly are those
"revelations"
that you serve, anyway?

units.rawText: The revelations are beyond question. Those are the earliest memories inscribed in a Sanctifier's Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: The revelations are beyond question. Those are the earliest memories inscribed in a Sanctifier's Sacred Canon.

spans.text: The revelations are beyond question. Those are the earliest memories inscribed in a Sanctifier's Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: Then who passed down those memories, missions, faith, and hatreds that are beyond question?
units.displayText: Then who passed down those memories, missions, faith, and hatreds that are beyond question?

spans.text: Then who passed down those memories, missions, faith, and hatreds that are beyond question?

units.rawText: Hesperus is having a hard time on the border battlefront. Sanctifiers die with every minute, every second that passes.
units.displayText: Hesperus is having a hard time on the border battlefront. Sanctifiers die with every minute, every second that passes.

spans.text: Hesperus is having a hard time on the border battlefront. Sanctifiers die with every minute, every second that passes.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, your closest comrades are dying one after another in Tartarus. Why not call a temporary retreat?
units.displayText: Meanwhile, your closest comrades are dying one after another in Tartarus. Why not call a temporary retreat?

spans.text: Meanwhile, your closest comrades are dying one after another in Tartarus. Why not call a temporary retreat?

units.rawText: We are the guardians of Magrasea, the defenders of the cloud server. We fight for the safety of all sectors.
units.displayText: We are the guardians of Magrasea, the defenders of the cloud server. We fight for the safety of all sectors.

spans.text: We are the guardians of Magrasea, the defenders of the cloud server. We fight for the safety of all sectors.

units.rawText: Oh Eosphorus, you are the leader of the Sanctifiers, the greatest of all agents, an entity on the same level as me.
units.displayText: Oh Eosphorus, you are the leader of the Sanctifiers, the greatest of all agents, an entity on the same level as me.

spans.text: Oh Eosphorus, you are the leader of the Sanctifiers, the greatest of all agents, an entity on the same level as me.

units.rawText: Yet your answer is forced and mechanical.
units.displayText: Yet your answer is forced and mechanical.

spans.text: Yet your answer is forced and mechanical.

units.rawText: Like a puppet dancing on strings.
units.displayText: Like a puppet dancing on strings.

spans.text: Like a puppet dancing on strings.

units.rawText: Hahahahahahaha.
units.displayText: Hahahahahahaha.

spans.text: Hahahahahahaha.

units.rawText: Malkira shakes her head.
units.displayText: Malkira shakes her head.

spans.text: Malkira shakes her head.

units.rawText: It seems you will need a greater... stimulus.
units.displayText: It seems you will need a greater... stimulus.

spans.text: It seems you will need a greater... stimulus.

units.rawText: As she finishes speaking, Eosphorus sees three arrows climbing into the sky.
units.displayText: As she finishes speaking, Eosphorus sees three arrows climbing into the sky.

spans.text: As she finishes speaking, Eosphorus sees three arrows climbing into the sky.

units.rawText: He sends Malkira flying with a kick and pulls away again.
units.displayText: He sends Malkira flying with a kick and pulls away again.

spans.text: He sends Malkira flying with a kick and pulls away again.

units.rawText: Three... signal arrows.
units.displayText: Three... signal arrows.

spans.text: Three... signal arrows.

units.rawText: Alcyone...
units.displayText: Alcyone...

spans.text: Alcyone...

units.rawText: For the first time, there is a change in Eosphorus' expression.
units.displayText: For the first time, there is a change in Eosphorus' expression.

spans.text: For the first time, there is a change in Eosphorus' expression.

units.rawText: I salute her bravery. If only my subordinates were as capable.
units.displayText: I salute her bravery. If only my subordinates were as capable.

spans.text: I salute her bravery. If only my subordinates were as capable.

units.rawText: Still, that's fine. That's alright.
units.displayText: Still, that's fine. That's alright.

spans.text: Still, that's fine. That's alright.

units.rawText: Inside Tartarus... all operands are mine to command.
units.displayText: Inside Tartarus... all operands are mine to command.

spans.text: Inside Tartarus... all operands are mine to command.

units.rawText: Snap—
units.displayText: Snap—

spans.text: Snap—

units.rawText: Malkira snaps her fingers, and Ptolemaea, who has nearly been killed by Eosphorus, is instantly restored to full health.
units.displayText: Malkira snaps her fingers, and Ptolemaea, who has nearly been killed by Eosphorus, is instantly restored to full health.

spans.text: Malkira snaps her fingers, and Ptolemaea, who has nearly been killed by Eosphorus, is instantly restored to full health.

units.rawText: All you have to do is take my hand... and meet me in the Throne Room.
units.displayText: All you have to do is take my hand... and meet me in the Throne Room.

spans.text: All you have to do is take my hand... and meet me in the Throne Room.

units.rawText: She extends a hand to Eosphorus, and her pierced palm looks like it is waiting for Eosphorus' response.
units.displayText: She extends a hand to Eosphorus, and her pierced palm looks like it is waiting for Eosphorus' response.

spans.text: She extends a hand to Eosphorus, and her pierced palm looks like it is waiting for Eosphorus' response.

units.rawText: I can also show you a token of my sincerity...
units.displayText: I can also show you a token of my sincerity...

spans.text: I can also show you a token of my sincerity...

units.rawText: You can be reunited with them—With Alcyone, Electra... ah, and of course, Atlas.
units.displayText: You can be reunited with them—With Alcyone, Electra... ah, and of course, Atlas.

spans.text: You can be reunited with them—With Alcyone, Electra... ah, and of course, Atlas.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' blade flashes past, hacking off Malkira's extended hand.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' blade flashes past, hacking off Malkira's extended hand.

spans.text: Eosphorus' blade flashes past, hacking off Malkira's extended hand.

units.rawText: Alcyone, you've done well... thank you for your hard work.
units.displayText: Alcyone, you've done well... thank you for your hard work.

spans.text: Alcyone, you've done well... thank you for your hard work.

units.rawText: Your efforts...
units.displayText: Your efforts...

spans.text: Your efforts...

units.rawText: Eosphorus extends his own right hand toward Malkira and Ptolemaea, his face blank.
units.displayText: Eosphorus extends his own right hand toward Malkira and Ptolemaea, his face blank.

spans.text: Eosphorus extends his own right hand toward Malkira and Ptolemaea, his face blank.

units.rawText: This is followed by an overpowering surge of starlight arrows that rains down on them.
units.displayText: This is followed by an overpowering surge of starlight arrows that rains down on them.

spans.text: This is followed by an overpowering surge of starlight arrows that rains down on them.

units.rawText: Hahahahaha! Yes, that's right, Eosphorus! I'll be waiting for you... Waiting in the Throne Room!
units.displayText: Hahahahaha! Yes, that's right, Eosphorus! I'll be waiting for you... Waiting in the Throne Room!

spans.text: Hahahahaha! Yes, that's right, Eosphorus! I'll be waiting for you... Waiting in the Throne Room!
